settings.title: Your order arrives
settings.body: Order your tires on TireDrop and send them to your address or free to the Sunrise shop. Already have tires sitting in the garage? That works too.

settings.title: Book the van
settings.body: Send us the service, the vehicle and the day that suits you with the booking request form. Prefer a human? Call and we will write it up for you.

settings.title: We confirm a 2-hour window
settings.body: A dispatcher confirms the appointment and locks in a two-hour arrival window, so you are not burning a whole day waiting on a van.

settings.title: Fitted where you parked
settings.body: Mounted, balanced, torqued to spec and pressures set — in your own driveway. Your old set leaves with us. You never went anywhere.

Mount and seat new tires on your wheels

settings.question: Is mobile install available everywhere you ship?
settings.answer: No, and we will not pretend otherwise. TireDrop ships tires to the continental United States, but the vans are a South Florida service run out of the Sunrise shop. If you are outside the Broward cities listed on this page, your order ships to you and you take it to a fitter you trust.

settings.question: I bought my tires here. Can the van bring them to me?
settings.answer: That is exactly what it is for. Send the order free to the Sunrise shop at checkout, then book a mobile install — the van loads your set and brings it to your address. If you had them shipped to your house instead, leave them where they are and we will fit them there.

settings.question: Does the van cost more than coming into the shop?
settings.answer: No. Mobile labor is billed at the same rate as the bay — tire installation starts at $25 per tire either way. Within the local install area there is no trip fee on standard appointments.

settings.question: How much room does the van need?
settings.answer: One standard parking space next to your vehicle and about ten feet of clearance on the work side. A driveway, a flat stretch of street, an office lot or a jobsite staging area all work. We do not need your garage and we do not need a lift.

settings.question: What happens if it rains?
settings.answer: South Florida rain is part of the job. Short afternoon showers rarely stop us — the van carries lighting and cover for the work area. If there is lightning or sustained heavy rain, we call you, pause the job and reschedule at the front of the next available window. You are never charged for weather.

settings.question: Can you come to an apartment or condo complex?
settings.answer: Yes, and we do it every week. Some complexes want the van checked in at the gate or ask that work happen in a visitor space rather than a covered garage. Tell us the complex name and any gate code or call-up instructions when you book and we will handle it with management on arrival.

settings.question: How long does a mobile appointment take?
settings.answer: A four-tire installation runs about 45 to 75 minutes. A single flat repair is roughly 30 minutes, a rotation about 30, and a full-synthetic oil change 30 to 45. Your confirmation lists the estimate for the exact service you booked.

settings.question: What if my vehicle needs work the van cannot do?
settings.answer: Brakes, alignment, suspension, lift kits and diagnostics are bay work — they need a lift and an alignment rack, so they happen at the Sunrise shop. If the tech spots something like that in your driveway, you will hear it straight, with an estimate, and we will get you on the schedule there.
